question.proposal:
The owned Node runtime adds a dedicated read-only readiness-plan endpoint with proof_kind completed-readiness. The endpoint verifies the current operation resource closure, exact managed association, frozen configuration, selected retained context and adapter facts, but does not rerun ordinary draft-only During admission or rehash completed HI project source snapshots. Ordinary freeze, occurrence and delivery paths retain their existing actual-scope guards and cannot consume completed-readiness proof as a business proof.

Python prepare_hook_admission runs outside writer scopes and retains an ephemeral trusted Store-only proof cache. Cache identity binds the exact selected HC set, chain hash/revision, raw private locator hash, actual admitted context, original watch map and execution root. No JSON/caller proof or persistent second readiness ledger supplies authority. Direct public hook_admission outside the writer prepares and pure-validates. Inside the writer, a missing or mismatching current preflight yields a prerequisite without starting Node. The pure check re-enumerates matching actual chains, resolves replacement lineage, verifies scope/context/watch/policy/HC/locator identities and consumes applicable global or unknown/malformed outstanding requirements. Historical binding-specific capability loss does not retroactively invalidate accepted occurrences. Relevant additions or drift reject without writing; known unrelated scoped obligations do not block the selected task. The cache belongs only to the current operation and receives pure writer/commit rechecks rather than becoming a reusable stale acceptance.

Real callers prepare before their writer scopes and repeat guarded selection inside: process uses only promoted/resolved selected Pending; complete only completed disposition and exact task; begin/select/advance/current next selection preserve exact scope and required dependency boundaries; start derives the exact selected snapshot/dependency closure without mutating state during preflight and recomputes inside; finish prepares exact current controller or maintenance chain references. PR readiness and merge-gate prepare referenced WF chains with the actual review context under the publication lock before the writer lock; ordinary publication authorization remains unchanged. No-ref and core-only operations create no Node requirement, external plugin hold, Future or invocation.

# Managed Registry and Prerequisite Admission Plan

## Admitted scope

The explicit Implement All run selected T-54439a41-286c-4423-936c-eb27663509c3 as a required blocker beneath the admitted review pilot. The task repairs managed-operation registry authority and current invocation prerequisite consumption. The task preserves the existing installation format, original invocation identities, accepted prefixes and standalone operation closure.

The retained missing-registry observation and current source establish the defect. The completed invocation dependency passed current 55 state, eight copied-installation and twelve oracle controls. The immutable actual-host report passed current static validation against the unchanged captured mandatory runtime identities. The current task introduces no actual-host, candidate-efficacy, native Skill, real-human consent or product-runtime qualification claim.

## Implementation sequence

1. Add requirements-led regression controls before changing runtime behavior. Use actual receipt-owned destinations for managed association, independent copies for portability, and the existing pure-engine and workflow bridge fixtures for current prerequisites and original-attempt retention. Record expected behavioral Red before the runtime repair.
2. In the bundled composition/runtime layer, establish association from the actual execution project, exact package destination, operation and complete verified receipt inventory. Verify the existing deterministic receipt identity formula locally without importing installer/composer code. An associated selected operation requires the associated live registry; invalid relevant ownership claims remain prerequisites. Independent standalone copies and unrelated valid profiles retain current behavior.

The default Node private delivery path and cached trusted Python callback path both enforce the same applicability before providers or sinks execute.

Prove the A to B to A sequence with distinct occurrence IDs and default Node delivery: an editor-only capability loss after A1 preserves A1, permits valid B incorporation, blocks A2, and restoration delivers the accepted B context to A2. Update the canonical invocation/metadata contracts, generate standalone resources, run current focused and full repository validation, review the complete scoped diff independently, resolve findings and repeat affected checks.
